name: jurin
curiosities: Jurin started snowboarding at the age of 3 and became a professional athlete at 12, winning several championships.
By fifteen, she was working as a model, collaborating with brands such as Drop Tokyo and Popteen.
Jurin enjoys skateboarding and surfing, a hobby she shares with her father, who is also a surfer.
She likes listening to alternative pop, R&B, and Japanese artists, with Willow Smith and TLC among her favorites.
Her name was inspired by the character “PomPomPurin,” given to her by her sister.

name: chisa
curiosities: Before the debut, Chisa worked as an actress and model under Kansai Collection Entertainment.
She took part in music competitions and even won the Tokyo Girls Audition.
Her biggest inspirations are Namie Amuro, Madonna, Beyoncé, and Rihanna.
Her hobbies include playing the guitar, cooking, and doing makeup (both for herself and for the other members).
Chisa was the first member of the group to get a tattoo.

name: hinata
curiosities: Hinata have Japanese and South Korean descent.
Before becoming a trainee, she attended a local dance school, where the school staff encouraged her to audition for XG.
Her hobbies include drawing, watching anime, and reading manga. Some of her favorites are Haikyu!! and Your Lie in April.
Her favorite artist is SOLE, and her inspirations include TLC, Tamia, and ZARD.
Hinata used to play volleyball.

name: harvey
fullName: Amy Jannet Harvey (ハーヴィー瑛美)
curiosities: Harvey lived in Australia when she was younger. Her mother is Japanese and her father is Australian
Before becoming a trainee under XGALX, she worked as a model, appearing in commercials alongside Jurin and collaborating with brands such as VOGUE GIRL.
Her icon is Michael Jackson, having him as her inspiration, along with Doja Cat and the Spice Girls.
One of her hobbies is photography.
Harvey has a pet dog and a parakeet.

name: juria
curiosities: Before the debut, Juria was already a model, child actress, and singer, and was part of the youth idol group Amorecarina.
She appeared on TV programs such as Hirunandesu, Onegai Ranking, and Piramekino, as well as in a commercial for the Nintendo 3DS - Ciao Illust Club.
She took part in competitions like Kiratto Challenge and Tokyo Girls Audition, and won the Best Performance Award (Avex VTS Best P).
Her mother inspired her artistic career, and Juria looks up to artists such as Ariana Grande, Jessie J, and Beyoncé.
She loves sweets, cute things, and amusement parks, though she's afraid of roller coasters.

name: maya
curiosities: Maya studied at an international school in Japan, where she became fluent in English, being the most fluent member of the group.
Before debuting with XG, she took part in the Tokyo Girls Audition 2017.
In 2023, she joined the Street Woman Fighter 2 (SWF2) Crew Songs project, co-writing and producing the song “Show You Can” with Cocona.
She's a fan of Silk Sonic, and her inspirations include Destiny's Child and Bruno Mars.
Enjoys collecting stickers, watching Modern Family, and is afraid of birds.

name: cocona
curiosities: Cocona won the Kira Challe 2018 music competition, performing BIGBANG's “Haru Haru”, a group he's a big fan of.
In 2024, he went viral on social media after shaving his head during the filming of the “WOKE UP” music video.
Some of his hobbies include meditating and journaling. Him often reflects on the kind of artist he wants to become.
Cocona has a tattoo on his right wrist with the kanji “龍,” which means “dragon” in Japanese.

In his 20th birthday, Cocona came out as a transmasculine non-binary person, using the pronouns he/him and they/them.
"I was born and perceived as female, but that label never represented who I truly am. I live in a way that feels more masculine and true to who I am. The hardest thing I've ever faced was accepting and embracing myself. But as I slowly began to do that, I was able to open a new door. That moment changed the way I see and understand the world, and it gave me the courage and strength to grow."
